quote: A veneer is finished when it disappears into the smile, not when it comes off the mill.

focus.d: Every piece is milled from multilayer zirconia, then seated and adjusted by hand under magnification until it fits without pressure, with the margin polished into a closed seal at the gum line.
Shade is matched in person with the patient in the chair, not from a photo. On front teeth Edgar builds surface texture and enamel effects by hand over the gradient already in the disc.
Because the lab is in the building, adjustments happen between visits instead of in a courier's van. That is what makes the Monday-to-Thursday week possible.
Edgar also plans and installs dental laboratories for other practices: milling, sintering and finishing workflows, and the training of the teams who run them.

lab.title: Inside the lab that makes every Xiluet smile
lab.body: Edgar's lab is in the same building as the treatment rooms. Your doctor and your ceramist look at the same scans, the same design and the same shade, with you in the chair, and every veneer, crown and bridge is finished here, by hand, before it goes into your mouth.

facts.sub: of shade built into every zirconia disc

lab.processTitle: How a veneer is made here

process.d: 3D scans and facial photos replace impressions. You see the design in your own mouth and approve it before any tooth is touched.
Each veneer is milled from a multilayer zirconia disc, positioned so the warm-to-translucent gradient falls where it does in a natural tooth.
Edgar fits every piece under magnification until it seats without pressure, polishes the margin into a closed seal and adds surface texture and enamel effects by hand.
Doctor and ceramist match the shade with you in the chair and correct it on the spot, not by email with a lab in another city.

process.t: Bonded, with the warranty in writing
process.d: Final bonding the same week you arrived. The bite is checked and the 5-year warranty is handed over on paper.

lab.processIntro: Most clinics scan you, ship the file to a lab in another city and wait. Here the lab is a flight of stairs from the chair, so every step below happens with the same people, in the same week.
lab.processNote: If something needs a change on delivery day, it goes upstairs and comes back the same afternoon. Nobody waits for a courier.
